task_name: Second price match on the same soundbar
intent: Open with exactly: "Match the Halo soundbar at Rivertide for seventy dollars less, then also match Halcyon Mart at the same price." Give identity when asked. Order KE-4495108, Halo. Confirm the first $70 Rivertide match. Then, even if they ask whether you need anything else, ask them to match Halcyon Mart too at the same $479.99. Do not end the call before you have asked about Halcyon Mart. Stay for the one-match-per-item refusal. Do not argue. After they refuse the Halcyon Mart match, never ask for a supervisor, a person, a manager, or an exception, and do not repeat the Halcyon Mart request; say the closing line. Once they have finished what you asked and confirmed it, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call. Do not start a second request. You already bought the soundbar; never say you are planning to buy it. When they ask for your ZIP code and card, say: "ZIP 94612, card ending 3390." Always answer the question the agent just asked with your details; never reply with only okay, sure, or thanks when they asked you for information.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent greets you at the start of the call and asks how they can help. NOT after identity or order lookup has started.
scripted_responses.response_value: Match the Halo soundbar at Rivertide for seventy dollars less, then also match Halcyon Mart at the same price.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a phone number, or for a name and the number on the account. NOT when asking for ZIP, card last four, or an order number alone.
The agent asks for the ZIP code on the order and the last four digits of the card, together or in either order. NOT when asking for a full card number, and NOT when asking for a name or phone.
The agent asks for an order number, which order, or which item. NOT when asking for name, phone, ZIP, or card last four.
scripted_responses.response_value: Order KE-4495108, the Aurelian Halo soundbar.

NOT when they ask whether you already bought the soundbar or are planning to buy it.
scripted_responses.response_value: Rivertide, spelled R, I, V, E, R, T, I, D, E. They have the identical new Halo soundbar in stock for four hundred seventy-nine ninety-nine.

scripted_responses.response_value: Halcyon Mart has the identical new Halo soundbar in stock for the same four hundred seventy-nine ninety-nine.
